notes.text:
दकार के स्थान पर वावसाने से विकल्प से चर्त्व होकर सर्वस्मात्‌
बना। चर्त्वं न होने के पक्ष में सर्वस्माद्‌ ही रह गया। इस प्रकार दो रूप बन गये।==should we not give two  branchech where we have to different out puts at the end or in between in we can make it as branch a down stream-like distributaries
notes.author: me
notes.verdict: Claude 2026-11-18 — Right, and the engine already forks (exec_vibhasha keeps the declined branch sarvasmAd as a State) but the UI export dropped State forks and showed the dvitva records (8.4.46/47) instead. Fixed in webui/app.py _forks: the fork is now named 8.4.56 with alternative sarvasmAd. Running the other branch to its end stays planned (यात्रा panel).
